title: Twins, but Different
subtitle: 考点：比较人物 / as ... as / 性格
passage: Sam and Dan are twins. They look almost the same: both are tall and slim with short black hair. But their personalities are very different.

Sam is outgoing and loud. He loves talking to people and he is never shy. At school, he often performs on the stage. Dan is quiet and a little shy. He likes to spend his spare time reading alone in his room. He is not as talkative as his brother, but he is more serious about his homework.

Even so, they have a lot in common. Both of them love basketball, and they both play the flute. Sam says, “Dan is not as outgoing as I am, but he is a great friend.” Dan says, “Sam makes me laugh every day.” Their differences do not stop them from being close.
